name: Maplelms
description_en:
MapleLMS is a SaaS learning-management offering with course delivery, assessments, certifications and reporting. Its product family also includes Salesforce-oriented LMS, online exams, AI proctoring and authoring tools.

The named products and integrations need a scoped proposal: a proctoring page or a Salesforce logo does not establish that every capability is included in an ordinary LMS account.
description_zh:
MapleLMS 是 SaaS 学习管理产品，包含课程交付、考核、认证和报告，产品家族另有 Salesforce LMS、在线考试、AI 监考及创作工具。

这些产品和集成需要明确采购范围，监考页面或 Salesforce 标识不能证明普通 LMS 账户包含全部能力。

core_features.explanation_en: Deliver courses and track completion, assessment and certificates.
core_features.explanation_zh: 交付课程并跟踪完成、考核和证书。

core_features.explanation_en: The product family includes Salesforce LMS and named business-system integrations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品家族含 Salesforce LMS 及具名业务系统集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Online Exam and AI Proctoring require their own scope check.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在线考试和 AI 监考需单独核对范围。

zh: 示例：会员继续教育培训
use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Custom quote by organization and area of interest; 15-day trial, no verified ongoing free tier.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按机构和意向产品定制报价；15 天试用，未核实持续免费版。

sources.title: AI First: Learning Management System (LMS) - LMS Software
sources.research_notes_en: Read SaaS positioning, LMS versus exam/proctoring/authoring family, reporting, offline and Salesforce claims.

sources.title: LMS Pricing - Request Pricing - What Is the Cost of an LMS?
sources.research_notes_en: Read quote request with employee bands and product interest, plus 15-day no-card trial; no rate published.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Learning records with adjacent assessment products
sections.title_zh: 学习记录与相邻考核产品
sections.en: The homepage describes branded training, reporting, continuing education, certification and course creation. It lists Salesforce and other CRM/association-management integrations, as well as offline learning. Online Exam and AI Proctoring are separately named offerings. Verify exact connectors and entitlement rather than carrying every family capability into the core LMS description.
sections.zh: 首页介绍品牌培训、报告、继续教育、认证和创课，列出 Salesforce 及其他 CRM、协会管理集成，并介绍离线学习。Online Exam 和 AI Proctoring 是另外命名的产品，应确认具体连接器及权益，不能把家族全部能力归入核心 LMS。

sections.title_zh: 示例：会员继续教育培训
sections.en: Use a small member group, assign a course and verify the completion record, credit award and certificate against expected rules. If syncing with a CRM or association system, inspect the identity match and both sides of an updated record. Test a failed exam and an interrupted offline-to-online session before relying on reporting completeness. This is an editorial acceptance plan; no connector or exam was run.
sections.zh: 用小型会员组分配课程，按预期规则核对完成记录、学分和证书。若与 CRM 或协会系统同步，应检查身份匹配及记录更新两端。依赖报告完整性前，应测试考试失败和离线转在线中断。本例是编辑建议，本文未运行连接器或考试。

sections.title_en: Request a quote for the specific area of interest
sections.en: The pricing form requests employee count bands and an area of interest such as LMS, Online Assessment, AI Proctoring or Salesforce LMS. It publishes no numeric rate or universal billing meter. A trial form advertises 15 days without a card, but that does not establish an ongoing free plan. Request the learner definition, product bundle, integration setup, storage and proctoring charges in one itemized proposal.
sections.zh: 定价表单询问员工规模及 LMS、在线考核、AI 监考或 Salesforce LMS 等产品意向，没有公开金额或通用计费单位。试用表单宣传 15 天且无需信用卡，并不意味着持续免费。应在分项报价中确认学员定义、产品组合、集成配置、存储和监考费用。

sections.title_en: Treat integrations and privacy as implementation work
sections.title_zh: 把集成和隐私作为实施工作
sections.en: Start with a hosted pilot and a named administrator, then confirm roles and report exports. Claims about accessibility, adaptive learning and proctoring scale need tests against the actual audience and exam policy; they are not independently verified here. MapleLMS may fit recurring internal or member training, while a simple media library has narrower needs. Contract data location, source licensing, restoration and offline limitations remain unverified.
sections.zh: 从托管试点和明确管理员开始，再确认角色及报告导出。无障碍、自适应学习和监考规模需要按真实人群及考试政策测试，本文未独立验证。它可能适合重复开展内部或会员培训，仅需媒体库的需求则更窄。合同数据位置、源码许可、恢复及离线限制仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify product bundle, exact integration direction, offline sync limits, proctoring terms and contract data handling.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认产品组合、具体集成方向、离线同步限制、监考条款和合同数据处理。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
